message: バッドオクトーバーを追え！

name: Lolotte
message: 「I've been putting in some steady sales efforts of my own, you know!」

name: Misa
message: 「What an admirable attitude.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And so, this is a vital mission ordered directly by the librarian.」
For some reason, that librarian in the distance―Melilot―is letting out a sigh.

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's the Angel Squad's debut match, huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「You're not going to retort?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Never mind that. Now, let's announce the all-important operation name. Go ahead, Senpai.」

name: Ria
message: 「'Track Down the Missing Top-Secret Document!'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ooh, what a lively title!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Apparently, a certain book has been missing for a few days now.」

name: Misa
message: 「A certain book?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's a novel called 'A Maiden's KISEKI is 10 Billion Light-Years,' though.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What is with that embarrassing title? That's not top-secret at all.」

name: Ria
message: 「Let's not say that♪」
Having lost to Lolotte's enthusiastic sales pitch, she decided to give them the request for now.

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, what's wrong?」

name: Misa
message: 「N-No... it's nothing.」

name: Misa
message: 「How strange. I'm sure I returned that book right after reading it the other day. Could someone other than me have...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Apparently, it went missing just recently.」

name: Misa
message: 「Nobody checked it out, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. It wasn't in the lending records.」

name: Ria
message: 「And I don't think you can sneak things out of this library without permission either~」

name: Synn
message: 「Which means there's a high chance someone read it and just left it somewhere inside the building, huh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「To summarize, that's about the gist of it.」

name: Ria
message: 「I really don't think Melilot-san would ever overlook something like that, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「By the way, what kind of book is it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Apparently it has a cute, pastel-ish design. They say it's obvious at a glance just by looking at the spine.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just like the prompt says, I bet it's a girls' novel!」

name: Misa
message: 「...Anyway, let's split up and search. I don't really want to think about it, but there's a chance it was stolen, too.」
At her grave tone, everyone swallowed hard.
Even looking at the spines lined up on the bookshelf, the matching title is nowhere to be found.

name: Misa
message: 「Not that one. Not this one either.」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe it's over here~」

name: Misa
message: 「Why are you coming over here?! There's no point if we don't split up!」
Having been yelled at out of nowhere, I reluctantly head somewhere else.

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm, hmm. I see.」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you reading what's inside?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh? Oh, I did it again. Even though this isn't the time to be doing something like this.」
She gives her own head a light knock with her fist.

name: Synn
message: 「I totally thought you were checking the contents too.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No, whenever I find something that looks interesting, I just end up getting absorbed in it...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha. It's just like getting lost in a book you find while cleaning.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Heehee, yes, it is.」
Though, I don't even own enough books to need to clean them out.

name: Synn
message: 「Still, this is the exact same thing Melilot-san would do, isn't it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because she might have accidentally overlooked it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Like Ria-senpai said too, she's really reliable, so I don't think she'd make a mistake like that.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is that so? Then maybe someone ate it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha, it's not like we're talking about Paqy here.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You finally remember me after all this time, and that's how you treat me? That's harsh, man.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. Panda. Since you went through the trouble of coming out, please cooperate with us.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Let's see... This library is neatly organized. No, it's organized a little too well.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, the person managing it is that kind of guy, after all.」

name: Paqy
message: 「The spines are all lined up nice and even. This ain't a bookstore, so there's no need to go out of the way to display the covers or the insides.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mmm-hmm.」

name: Paqy
message: 「When it's kept this clean, anyone putting a book back is bound to be careful too. That's only natural when things are arranged this meticulously.」

name: Paqy
message: 「A completely, perfectly managed bookshelf. And an incident that happened within it. Rather than blindly searching for the answer, I think we oughta look for anything that feels out of place.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see.」
I gather everyone together for a moment and share the information from Paqy.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Something out of place, huh? I don't really come here much in the first place, so I have no clue.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're useless.」

name: Ria
message: 「In that case, asking a regular is our best bet\s04」
Saying that, Ria-senpai shifts her gaze toward Misa and gives a cute wink.

name: Misa
message: 「Ehhh?!」

name: Ria
message: 「It's nothing to be embarrassed about, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right, Vice President. There's no need to feel bad just because you don't have many friends.」

name: Misa
message: 「I do not have few friends! I just like reading!」

name: Ria
message: 「If it's you, Misa-chan, maybe you'll notice whatever's out of place?」

name: Misa
message: 「Aah, Onee-sama is counting on me... I have to show her my best side here!」

name: Misa
message: 「Leave it to me.」
With Misa leading the way, we look around.

name: Lolotte
message: 「There are so many~. Could it be that every single book in the world is in here?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hahaha, come on, there's no way. I'm sure it won't end with just this」

name: Ria
message: 「We don't have the space to store them, after all. Still, we want to collect as many different titles as possible, so no matter how popular a book is, we never stock multiple copies」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is that so~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sounds like people are gonna fight over them」

name: Synn
message: 「That's got nothing to do with you, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What was that!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, isn't that...!?」
Misa cried out and picked up a certain book.

name: Misa
message: 「This book... they had it at the library, too」
It was a book titled 'The Snow-Clad Woman'.

name: Paqy
message: 「Now that's a classic piece of pure literature」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're surprisingly knowledgeable, even though you're just a panda」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, so you read books like this, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「Eh?」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, r-right, right. I do! Got a problem with that?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I think it suits you」

name: Misa
message: 「Wha--! A-A-Are you making fun of me!?」
Why am I getting yelled at?

name: Paqy
message: 「That part where the couple stranded on the snowy mountain yells 'Somebody help us!' and then an avalanche hits and that's the end really makes you cry」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, yes, that's right. I just couldn't stop crying at that part」

name: Paqy
message: 「There's no scene like that. In fact, I've never even read it」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-Th-There is too! A touching scene just like that!」

name: Ria
message: 「Urgh... *sniff*... Someone hurry and go save them... Mr. Rescue Worker...」
Ria-senpai was reading it and crying.

name: Lolotte
message: 「It seems a bear truly did come out of the gourd, didn't it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Roro-chan, pick one--are you an idiot or sharp?」

name: Misa
message: 「Aaah!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Kyaaah, you mustn't raise your voice in here--」

name: Misa
message: 「Aaah--!!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What's wrong?」

name: Misa
message: 「...All the mysteries have been solved.」

name: Ria
message: 「Really!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Another copy of this same book must be sleeping somewhere in here.」

name: Synn
message: 「Eeh!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Anyway, let's look for it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-Yeah. Got it.」
A book with the same title was found right away.
On the outside, it was a completely ordinary copy of "The Snow-Covered Woman."

name: Misa
message: 「I think you've already got a hunch, but--」
While speaking, she flips open the cover.

name: Misa
message: 「Library books have their dust jackets firmly taped down so they last longer.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mmm-hmm.」

name: Misa
message: 「This book hasn't had that done to it. Which means the dust jacket can be removed!」
And then, she slowly removed the dust jacket. Inside it was, lo and behold!

name: Synn
message: 「A Maiden's KISEKI is 10 Billion Light-Years!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aren't you embarrassed saying that out loud?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Amazing! How did you figure it out!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-That's... intuition, intuition. What you'd call a great detective's intuition.」

name: Ria
message: 「Mission accomplished! Way to go, Misa-chan.」

name: Misa
message: 「Uu... I feel so guilty. Still, I'm happy.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh my? The Vice President's name is listed on the checkout history.」

name: Synn
message: 「It really is.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And on top of that, you were the last one to borrow it」

name: Ria
message: 「Misa―chan, is this―」
When everyone looked over at once, Misa was sitting in seiza, writing a letter of apology.
